description: This file contains shell functions related to verifying firmware images and signatures during system upgrade processes in OpenWRT. It defines functions for checking image signatures and metadata, and performs compatibility checks for devices during firmware upgrade.

methods.name: fwtool_check_signature
methods.description: Checks the signature of a firmware image, verifies presence of signature, and optionally validates using ucert if available.

methods.name: fwtool_check_image
methods.description: Checks the metadata of a firmware image, verifies device compatibility, and determines whether the image can be flashed on the current device.
